pack.name: Internal-service starter policy
pack.description: Illustrative policies over recorded model properties and connections, not an organization standard. These examples do not certify compliance or verify deployed controls.

source.name: Illustrative internal-service policy; logging guidance from OWASP

rules.message: {name} is marked Internal but does not record a ServiceName matching the example svc-name convention.
rules.fullDescription: EXAMPLE-SVC-1: Internal services use a svc- prefix and lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens. This is an illustrative naming policy, not an OWASP requirement or evidence of a security control.
rules.helpText: Record an evidenced ServiceName such as svc-billing, or adapt the example pattern to your own naming policy. Missing names also fail this requirement.

rules.message: {name} is an externally reachable Internal service with no direct outgoing connection to a store marked StoresLogData=Yes.
rules.fullDescription: EXAMPLE-SVC-2: A service reachable along modeled directed paths from an external entity should have an explicit audit destination. The direct-store topology is an illustrative policy, not a requirement imposed by OWASP. It does not prove that events are actually logged.
rules.helpText: Model the evidenced audit-store connection and mark that store StoresLogData=Yes. Adapt this example for brokered or collector-based logging; an indirect path does not satisfy connectsTo.

provenance.location: OWASP Logging Cheat Sheet: Event collection
